Data Anaysis of Beetle Richness and Leaf Litter

Zachary krausman, Eryn Lackey, Riley Wares, and Afia Lockett

2026-03-24

Load in Packages

#install.packages("pacman")
library(pacman)
## Warning: package 'pacman' was built under R version 4.5.3
# Load packages (emmeans used for statistical tests)
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, here, cowplot, emmeans)

Import datasets from the accompanying “data_wrangle_official.Rmd” file

litter_averages_total <- read.csv(here("data", "processed", "litter_averages_total.csv"))
beetle_abundance_taxonID <- read.csv(here("data", "processed", "beetle_abundance_taxonID.csv"))
beetle_richness_taxonID <- read.csv(here("data", "processed", "beetle_richness_taxonID.csv"))

Preliminary visuals of beetle and litter observations per month.

ggplot(data = litter_averages_total, 
       aes(x = monthCollected))+
  geom_dotplot(dotsize = 0.025)
## Bin width defaults to 1/30 of the range of the data. Pick better value with
## `binwidth`.

ggplot(data = beetle_richness_taxonID, 
       aes(x = month(collectDate)))+
  geom_dotplot(dotsize = 0.025)
## Bin width defaults to 1/30 of the range of the data. Pick better value with
## `binwidth`.

A note to future explorers: We do not have data for the winter (or between march and october). We are choosing to focus on the rough growing season (april to october)

For discussion: it would be interesting to see what is visible in the winter, but requires more data.

Create average richness with the beetle data.

beetle_richness_monthly <- beetle_richness_taxonID %>% 
  mutate(monthCollected = month(collectDate), 
         yearCollected = year(collectDate)) %>%
  group_by(plotID, yearCollected, monthCollected) %>%
  summarize(avg_richness_monthly = mean(richness))
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'plotID', 'yearCollected'. You can override
## using the `.groups` argument.

Preparing beetle and litter data for joining including creating means.

beetle_richness_by_site_month <- beetle_richness_monthly %>%
  mutate(siteID = substring(plotID, 0, 4)) %>%
  group_by(siteID, yearCollected, monthCollected) %>%
  summarize(avg_richness_plotmonth = mean(avg_richness_monthly))
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'siteID', 'yearCollected'. You can override
## using the `.groups` argument.
litter_mass_by_site_month <- litter_averages_total %>%
  mutate(siteID = substring(plotID, 0, 4)) %>%
  group_by(siteID, yearCollected, monthCollected) %>%
  summarize(avg_mass_plotmonth = mean(avgmass), 
            avg_C_plotmonth = mean(avgCpercent),
            avg_N_plotmonth = mean(avgNpercent))
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'siteID', 'yearCollected'. You can override
## using the `.groups` argument.

Joining litter and beetle data! Dropping Carbon and Nitrogen due to no overlap with beetle data

beetle_litter_joined_table <- beetle_richness_by_site_month %>%
  full_join(litter_mass_by_site_month) %>%
  drop_na("avg_richness_plotmonth","avg_mass_plotmonth") %>%
  select(siteID, yearCollected, monthCollected, avg_richness_plotmonth, avg_mass_plotmonth)
## Joining with `by = join_by(siteID, yearCollected, monthCollected)`

Linear Model for beetle richness as a function of average leaf litter mass.

beetle_litter_lm <- lm(avg_richness_plotmonth ~ (avg_mass_plotmonth), data= beetle_litter_joined_table) 

summary(beetle_litter_lm)
## 
## Call:
## lm(formula = avg_richness_plotmonth ~ (avg_mass_plotmonth), data = beetle_litter_joined_table)
## 
## Residuals:
##     Min      1Q  Median      3Q     Max 
## -1.5742 -0.7772 -0.1276  0.6700  2.7674 
## 
## Coefficients:
##                     Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)         2.891186   0.106839  27.061   <2e-16 ***
## avg_mass_plotmonth -0.009981   0.010362  -0.963    0.337    
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Residual standard error: 0.9675 on 137 degrees of freedom
## Multiple R-squared:  0.006727,   Adjusted R-squared:  -0.0005232 
## F-statistic: 0.9278 on 1 and 137 DF,  p-value: 0.3371

Checking assumptions for a linear model.

par(mfrow = c(1, 3))

plot(beetle_litter_lm, which = 1:3)

shapiro.test(beetle_litter_lm$residuals)
## 
##  Shapiro-Wilk normality test
## 
## data:  beetle_litter_lm$residuals
## W = 0.95803, p-value = 0.0002978

Average leaf litter mass per month was not a significant predictor of average beetle richness per month as seen by the linear regression model’s p-value much greater than 0.05 (F(1, 137)=.9278, p=.337). A linear regression model was used as both average leaf litter mass per month and average beetle richness per month are continuous variables. However, the linear regression model did not met the required assumptions of normality due to its low p-value of less than .05 produced by the Shapiro test and the strong concentration of points on the right side of the residuals v fitted and scale location plots. However, this lack of leaf litter mass as a predictor of beetle richness leds us to wonder whether leaf litter may still be a predictor for beetle abundance.

Average leaf litter mass per month was not a significant predictor of average beetle richness per month as seen by the p-value much greater than 0.05 (F(1, 137) = 0.9278, p = 0.337).

Adding aggregate abundance per month variable to joined table.
r beetle_abundance_agg <- beetle_abundance_taxonID %>% mutate(siteID = substring(plotID, 0, 4)) %>% group_by(siteID, collectDate) %>% summarize(agg_abundance = sum(count)) %>% mutate(monthCollected = month(collectDate), yearCollected = year(collectDate)) %>% group_by(siteID, yearCollected, monthCollected) %>% summarize(avg_agg_abundance_monthly = mean(agg_abundance))
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'siteID'. You can override using the ## `.groups` argument. ## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'siteID', 'yearCollected'. You can override ## using the `.groups` argument.
Joining beetle abundance per month with litter mass per month.
r beetle_abundance_litter_joined <- beetle_litter_joined_table %>% full_join(beetle_abundance_agg)
## Joining with `by = join_by(siteID, yearCollected, monthCollected)`

(F(1, 137) = 4.066, p = 0.04572) There is a slight but significant negative relationship between the log of the average leaf litter mass per month and aggregate beetle abundance per month.

Export joined beetle richness and average leaf litter data.

Create aggregate beetle abundance

beetle_abundance_agg <- beetle_abundance_taxonID %>%
  mutate(siteID = substring(plotID, 0, 4)) %>%
  group_by(siteID, collectDate) %>%
  summarize(agg_abundance = sum(count)) %>%
  mutate(monthCollected = month(collectDate), 
         yearCollected = year(collectDate)) %>%
  group_by(siteID, yearCollected, monthCollected) %>%
  summarize(avg_agg_abundance_monthly = mean(agg_abundance))
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'siteID'. You can override using the
## `.groups` argument.
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'siteID', 'yearCollected'. You can override
## using the `.groups` argument.

Create beetle diversity index

beetle_DI <- beetle_abundance_taxonID %>%
  mutate(siteID = substring(plotID, 0, 4)) %>%
  group_by(siteID, collectDate) %>%
  summarize(simpsonsD = sum((count/(sum(count)))^2)^(-1), shannonH = -sum((count/sum(count))*log(count/sum(count)))) %>%
    mutate(monthCollected = month(collectDate), 
         yearCollected = year(collectDate)) %>%
  group_by(siteID, yearCollected, monthCollected) %>%
  summarize(avg_simpsonsD_monthly = mean(simpsonsD), avg_shannonH = mean(shannonH)) 
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'siteID'. You can override using the
## `.groups` argument.
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'siteID', 'yearCollected'. You can override
## using the `.groups` argument.

Joining created beetle diversity index and aggregate beetle abundance.

total_beetle_litter_joined_table <- beetle_litter_joined_table %>%
  inner_join(beetle_abundance_agg) %>%
  inner_join(beetle_DI)
## Joining with `by = join_by(siteID, yearCollected, monthCollected)`
## Joining with `by = join_by(siteID, yearCollected, monthCollected)`

Make linear model for created beetle diversity index and aggregate beetle abundance.

modelsimpsons <- lm(data = total_beetle_litter_joined_table, avg_simpsonsD_monthly ~ log(avg_mass_plotmonth))
